notes.title: The first map of the story game
notes.content:
Bad news:
I was vaccinated against corona, and due to side effects, I came down with a fever of 38.5 and severe muscle pain for 4 days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366873/6158c335257ceec290eb0730bd1c5b63bbc3b3d3.jpg[/img]
Good news: the side effect is almost gone and I'm already continuing to work on the map.
Added a lot of details, completely redesigned lighting (close to the final version), optimized (at the moment on my RTX2070 with ultra graphics settings in 1080p 150-220fps, in 4k 70-100fps)
With the introduction of enemies, the fps will drop a little, but not significantly.
Some screenshots. Remember not the fact that this is the final version of the map, I can cut something for the sake of performance, and somewhere where there is free fps - add.

notes.title: Update 01
notes.content:
[img]https://www.burmistr.ru/upload/iblock/383/%D0%BE%D0%B1%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B5.jpg[/img]
1. The DF_Aztec map is completed
2. Additional optimization of the application was made to reduce the load on the video memory.
3. Fixed the menu for adjusting sounds and music (in the last build, it mysteriously went off-screen)
4. Found a build error that makes it impossible to run the game in dx11 mode. Now it is set by default and the game should work even on win7 without any problems.
5. Optimize resource loading for low graphics settings. The graphics quality is better, the FPS is higher.

notes.title: Update 01 coming soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366873/fcaf7d154d329fcc9d26930ef7e670b603bdb740.jpg[/img]
The DF_Aztec map is almost complete.
1. The visual component is completely ready.
2. Fully optimized.
Now we are working on a more convenient way to pass it. Through a large number of tests, small edits are made, mainly related to shifting the platforms for not significant distances, in order to balance the map for beginners, but also not to make it too simple for more experienced players.
